$description: Tier 3 · Component knobs for the security set and the update kit (packages/ui: components/security/*, ui/update-status.tsx), restyled for the 2026-11 direction. Merged with component.json at build and emitted as --c-*. It adds knobs and re-declares a few that component.json holds (secret-field revealed-bg and meter colours, code group-gap): the security area owns them from 1.0. Every colour reads a role. Sizes that sit on the 4px spacing scale or the size roles need no knob.

review.$description: The review frame (ApprovalSheet, CrownJewelGate, LargeTypeView): a sheet in the compact width class, a dialog wider. Its dialog widths, margin and label column are the shared parts' own knobs (--c-dialog-question-min-width, -review-, -viewer-, --c-dialog-margin in overlays.json; --c-field-row-label-width in data-b.json), so the security set cannot drift from them. Only what the shared Sheet has no knob for stays here.

sheet-top-gap.$description: The least room a phone sheet leaves above itself, so the page behind still shows that it is a sheet.

mask-spacing.$description: Between the dots of the mask (Lockdown 40:357 draws them apart).

revealed-bg.$description: Behind a shown value, with a hairline round it (rule-box): a raised chip, so a shown secret reads as out in the open on the page and in a sheet. Body ink on it holds Lc 90 in every mode; an ink wash did not on stone. Was a warning tint before 1.0.

meter-weak.$description: The strength rule's cells for Weak: the critical ink, which holds Lc 30 as a solid on both grounds (the critical fill does not on graphite). The word is always beside them.

meter-fair.$description: The strength rule's cells for Fair.

meter-strong.$description: The strength rule's cells for Strong: the identity ink, which holds Lc 30 as a solid on both grounds (the identity fill does not on graphite).

group-gap.$description: Between a code's groups (482 193): about a space, as the Lockdown frames draw it.

row-min-height.$description: A row of the phone's Codes list: 100 (Lockdown 40:954).

tile-min-height.$description: A tile of the desktop Codes grid: 172. Figma draws it 170 (Lockdown 41:2487: 20 + 20 + 10 + 20 + 10 + 44 + 10 + 16 + 20), which is off the 4px grid; the decision record (section 10) puts every component on it, and outranks a drawn value. The parts inside keep Figma's positions from the top; the 2px go under the bar. Flagged for Sean.

tile-min-width.$description: The narrowest a tile gets in CodeDisplayList layout=grid before the grid drops a column.

tile-gap.$description: Between tiles: the 24 between desktop columns.

urgent-at.$description: Seconds left at which the countdown rule turns critical (Lockdown brief A1: the last 20 seconds). The 10-second announcement is separate.

digit-groups.$description: DigitGroups: a code in groups, to read aloud or compare.

gap.$description: Between groups: wider than a space, so groups read apart at a glance.

qr-code.$description: QrCode: one SVG path on a light square.

size.$description: 240, as the Wi-Fi guest card draws it (Lockdown brief I9).

hover.$description: state-hover inside the inverted surface, in the surface's own ink. 3%, not the page's 6%: on the light inverted ground a 6% wash takes body ink under Lc 90.

pressed.$description: state-pressed inside the inverted surface. 4%, for the same reason as hover.

muted-ink.$description: Assigned to --muted-foreground and --text-label inside. 76% (was 72%): label ink on the inverted ground holds Lc 60 in all eight modes.
